Huge news today. Thank you to @RussVought47 for rolling back the Biden Administration’s disastrous CFPB 1071 rule.

I fought for years against the Biden Administration’s 1071 rule, including through my PROTECTED Act, because it was far-reaching, imposed significant costs, and unfairly hurt our smallest community banks that serve rural and underserved communities. This new rule ensures small lenders can continue to meet the needs of Main Street businesses, and I’m proud to be a strong supporter.
